summary: All 23 tokens retain sense 1. The stable content is leaving an action to the participant's choice; permissive assent and dismissive irritation are pragmatic uses, not two lexical senses. The revised gloss removes the unsupported requirement of annoyance.

The glossary's stem-I Infectum classification is retained for this m-initial contact form. Directive force does not by itself justify an Imperativ box, and initial m- does not establish a Detransitive form. No new finite box is added.

Second-person forms in -ət address men and women (PrS 10/40, 16/15, 34/57, 36/20, 50/86, 62/12); the reader's masculine label at 16/15 and 62/12 is not accepted as established gender morphology. -itu is explicit second-person plural at PrS 77/15 and 85/75.
The input has məstafəl, məstaflət, mustaflət, məṣtaflitu and məṣṭafəl spellings. Preserve s/ṣ and t/ṭ and u/ə variation; the root heading ṣtfl is not silently respelled.

The source at 56/73 has məṣṭafəl mine w alle with plural robbers; the inherited məṣṭafli hənne mənne ele already records the same settle-it-with-him frame. No duplicate idiom or numbered sense is needed.

PrS attestation is relevant to the entry's unresolved geographical/contact note, but the occurrence alone does not establish origin, a borrowing route or a productive paradigm.
